experiments.scope: Exercises the binding geometry, Lemmas B' and C, the counted charges (H5') and the post-filter chain (H1-P1) at reduced size (proof.md Sections 3-6, 12); with about ten claws per trial it checks exactness, not rates. Trials 0..3: a first block drawn from SHAKE-256 of the seed and its real 38-step chaining value; r, ustart and a 2^17-aligned block of 2^17 consecutive a0 of W9 drawn from the seed; the binding 15-column x 2^19-row table of six-lane 256-bit buckets built from 2^17 consecutive words u (reduced size: about 1,900 entries, so no bucket fills and retention is not exercised here; retention is exercised at full scale in the C port and on forced buckets in selftest) and the counted scan including the A.31 post-filter chain and step 3b on every good pair. Every claw is verified three ways: against an independent search over the retained entries (claws_equal_ref), by rebuilding the real E16 of member x (claw_e16_bad = 0), and by evaluating the post-filters on the real words of both members (postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0). A pair is returned only if step 3b accepts (rows 16..21 pass and A34..A37, E34..E37 are equal); none is expected at this size. Trial 4 runs step 3b on the P8 pair itself. Trial 5 executes the six-lane 256-bit word test of Lemma B' for every kind, w and tag on words with random u fields. Trial 6 executes the bitsliced front end (bs_mask) on 16 seed-drawn batches of 256 a0 and compares every lane with the scalar probe predicate, and evaluates the worst-constant operation count of the register program (gbs_worst). Trials 7..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 (none expected at the reduced size; any returned pair is a full collision). Trials 0..3: claws_equal_ref = 1, claw_e16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws, dropped = 0, probes/a0 near 250/8192 and reads/probes near 31.2, claws consistent with expected_claws_milli/1000 = 160 x entries x 2^17 / 2^32 (Poisson). Trial 4: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014. Trial 5: probe_lanes_checked = 2304, probe_mismatches = 0. Trial 6: bs_mismatches = 0, bs_gates_max <= bs_gate_bound = bs_gate_worst = 846, bs_probing_lanes near 16 x 256 x 250/8192 = 125.

experiments.scope: Checks claw exactness and the row-16 gate on more frequent claws, with a different (full-frame) coverage geometry, and reports the rows 16..21 cumulative counts of every claw (proof.md Sections 3, 6, 9, 12); it is not a measurement of q3. Trials 0..3: a first block from SHAKE-256 of the seed and its real chaining value; full-frame coverage (all 1024 columns, so every scanned u is covered and both windows probe) over 2^16 consecutive words u, and 2^13 consecutive a0 of W9; every claw is checked against the independent search and its real E16 at the head and offset the scan named (row16_bad = 0), its post-filter flags against the real words, and both members are rebuilt and the tests of rows 16..21 of step 3b applied in order (cumulative rows_le16..rows_le21). Trial 4 runs step 3b on the P8 pair. No pair is returned by design (acceptance is about 2^-71 per good pair).
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design. Trials 0..3: claws_equal_ref = 1, row16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws, rows_le16 = claws, and the post-filter stage counts c1, c1c2 consistent with the rates 1/8 and 2^-6.34 of proof.md Section 6. Trial 4: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014.
